envelope.description: Add the build schemas foundation (BuildTaskStatus, common base, BuildTestVerdict)

body.title: Add the build schemas foundation (BuildTaskStatus, common base, BuildTestVerdict)
body.summary: Create src/workflow/runners/build/schemas.ts with the purely-additive base types the rest of s3 builds on: the BuildTaskStatus string-literal union ('completed' | 'failed' | 'blocked' | 'not-reached'), the BuildTaskCommon base (taskId, title, dependsOn, note?), and BuildTestVerdict ({ command, passed, exitCode, summary }, all readonly). BuildTestVerdict is the daemon's own authoritative per-Task verdict produced by running the test command extracted verbatim from the PlanTask; it appears only on the reached arm added in t2. No existing symbol is touched (migration step 1).
acceptanceChecks: src/workflow/runners/build/schemas.ts exports BuildTaskStatus ('completed' | 'failed' | 'blocked' | 'not-reached'), a BuildTaskCommon base (taskId, title, dependsOn, optional note), and BuildTestVerdict ({ command, passed, exitCode, summary }) with every field readonly.
The module is purely additive — `npm run build` (tsc) passes and no existing exported symbol is modified.

tests.name: schemas: a constructed BuildTestVerdict carries { command, passed, exitCode, summary } and BuildTaskStatus admits exactly the four literals ('completed' | 'failed' | 'blocked' | 'not-reached'), all fields readonly
